events.title: Release Date Revealed!
events.summary: Hello, commanders!While the Next Fest Demo allows you to sneak your final peek at what the game will look like, we are proud to announce the release date of the full game!D-Day is December 9 this year. Yep. This soon.So be ready to experience Rearmed in all its glory, with all the campaigns from previous games, hundreds upon hundreds of improvements, and so much more.Also, check out this kick-ass trailer we've prepared for you!

events.title: Second Playtest is open now!
events.summary: Greetings, Commanders!Today marks the start of the second open playtest for Theatre of War: Rearmed.The playtest will run for two weeks, from August 14th to August 28th.Registration is still open, and you can gain access via the game's main Steam page.The main focus of this iteration is multiplayer. Compared to the first playtest, 3 new maps have been added.
